messages:
Renee K: Quick note from testing on ~600-700px: when the search bar collapses into the header it overlaps the table action column on small phones. Repro: tap search, type a long query, then open row actions. Screenshot: https://redwood-screenshots/px-987 :mag:

Omar L: Thanks — saw that too. We're doing a hard collapse at 640px which doesn't account for expanded search input. Maybe the search should overlay only the content area and push the action column down instead of covering it.

Priya S: UX idea: keep search in the header but switch it to a floating pill that expands over content with a dim backdrop. That preserves table layout and keeps actions visible. Also add an explicit close X so it's obvious.

Sam V: Implementationally we need to ensure keyboard focus lands in the expanded pill and that the table remains scrollable underneath. Also avoid trapping focus unless the pill is modal.

Renee K: Good call. Also noticed table rows with multi-line tags cause row height thrash when search opens. Suggest clamping tag chips to 1 line on narrow widths and moving extra tags into a "+N" overflow chip that opens a popover.

Priya S: Proposed CSS for chip clamp: ```css
.chips { display:flex; gap:6px; }
.chip { max-width: 10ch; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
```

Omar L: Accessibility: overflow chip should have aria-label="show additional tags" and be keyboard focusable. Popover should trap focus while open and restore focus to the chip on close. Announce popover open with aria-live polite.

Sam V: Also caught a copy nit: small header label currently says "Search models" which is confusing when you're in Runs table. Suggest dynamic label: "Search (runs | models)" based on route. Short and clearer on mobile.

Priya S: Agree — dynamic label works. For the floating search pill, add a condensed placeholder on collapsed state: just a magnifier icon + short label so it doesn't take too much space.

ux-ci-bot: Visual test report: regression reg-2026-03-23-12 flagged — search overlay hides action menu at 648px.

Renee K: We also saw gesture conflict: swipe-to-close on the nav conflicts with horizontal swipe on table cards. On small devices, users intend horizontal scroll in the table but accidentally close the nav. Need a deadzone or require a longer swipe.\n
Omar L: Agreed. We'll add a horizontal gesture threshold: ignore swipe-to-close unless deltaX > 30% of nav width OR velocity > threshold. Pseudo: ```js
if (Math.abs(dx) > navWidth * 0.3 || velocityX > 0.7) closeNav();
```

Priya S: Small accessibility nit for screen readers: when the floating search opens, announce "Search opened" and set aria-hidden on non-search landmarks. Also ensure reduced-motion respects transitions.

Sam V: QA action: I'll run keyboard nav and screen reader checks once the PR lands. Also adding a small E2E step to ensure the overflow chip popover doesn't shift the table layout.

mobile-preview-bot: Preview build: https://preview.redwood/ux/search-pill-and-chip-overflow (build 2026.03.23-1502)

Renee K: Action items: Omar to prototype floating pill + gesture threshold, Priya to update chip UX + copy changes, Sam to run accessibility tests, I'll re-run visual diff. Target: iterate in next 48h. Thanks! :thumbsup:
